professionalSummary.text: The candidate is a Data Scientist with experience in building daily item-level sales forecasts for multiple locations using statistical and machine learning models.
professionalSummary.witness: Data Scientist, Burrow & Bean Coffee (April 2022 to August 2026): built daily item-level forecasts for 140 coffee shops with gradient-boosted models on sales history, weather and local events, feeding the bakery production plan;

experienceHighlights.text: The candidate has held Chartered Statistician (CStat) status with the Royal Statistical Society since July 2023.
experienceHighlights.witness: Chartered Statistician (CStat), Royal Statistical Society, awarded July 2023.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: The candidate has measured forecast accuracy with the supply team using weighted MAPE and bias by item family, reporting these metrics every Monday.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Agreed weighted MAPE and bias by item family as the accuracy measures with the supply planning team and reported them every Monday.

skills.text: The candidate has explained forecast changes to operations managers in plain language, such as the effect of school holidays and new menu items.
